messages.subject: Particulars of Claim v2 (Rosenthal mark-up) + schedule of loss
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Attached: (1) the Particulars of Claim with Catherine's tracked changes — she's bumped the s.35A interest claim from 4% to 5% (so £65,934 to date rather than £52,747) and added a mitigation averment; and (2) the schedule of loss, total £2,917,070 in direct losses plus interest. If you're happy I'll have a clean version prepared for issue.

James
